# The minimum C++ standard of OgreRenderSystem_GL and the modules it depends on
if ( LINUX32 )
  set( MODULE_MIN_CPP_STANDARD 14 )
endif( LINUX32 )
if ( LINUX64 )
  set( MODULE_MIN_CPP_STANDARD 14 )
endif( LINUX64 )
if ( WIN32 )
  set( MODULE_MIN_CPP_STANDARD 14 )
endif( WIN32 )
if ( WIN64 )
  set( MODULE_MIN_CPP_STANDARD 14 )
endif( WIN64 )
GUCEF_cpp_standard_is_below( "${MODULE_MIN_CPP_STANDARD}" MODULE_CPP_STANDARD_TOO_LOW )
if ( MODULE_CPP_STANDARD_TOO_LOW )
  GUCEF_add_skipped_module( OgreRenderSystem_GL "${MODULE_MIN_CPP_STANDARD}" )
  return()
endif()


if( LINUX32 )
  set( MODULE_NAME "OgreRenderSystem_GL" )
elseif( LINUX64 )
  set( MODULE_NAME "OgreRenderSystem_GL" )
elseif( WIN32 )
  set( MODULE_NAME "OgreRenderSystem_GL" )
elseif( WIN64 )
  set( MODULE_NAME "OgreRenderSystem_GL" )
endif()
if( LINUX32 )
  add_library( ${MODULE_NAME} ${ALL_FILES} )
elseif( LINUX64 )
  add_library( ${MODULE_NAME} ${ALL_FILES} )
elseif( WIN32 )
  add_library( ${MODULE_NAME} ${ALL_FILES} )
elseif( WIN64 )
  add_library( ${MODULE_NAME} ${ALL_FILES} )
endif()

if ( LINUX32 )
  add_dependencies( ${MODULE_NAME} Ogre OgreGLSupport )
  target_link_libraries( ${MODULE_NAME} PUBLIC Ogre OgreGLSupport )
target_link_libraries( ${MODULE_NAME} PRIVATE dl )
  set_property( TARGET ${MODULE_NAME} APPEND_STRING PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "MODULE_NAME=OgreRenderSystem_GL;MODULE_SEMVER=14_6_3_0;OGRE_GCC_VISIBILITY;OGRE_GLPLUGIN_EXPORTS;YY_NEVER_INTERACTIVE" )
target_compile_features( ${MODULE_NAME} PUBLIC cxx_std_14 )
if ( CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang" )
  target_compile_options( ${MODULE_NAME} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fvisibility=hidden;-fvisibility-inlines-hidden> )
endif()
if ( CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang" )
  target_compile_options( ${MODULE_NAME} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-fvisibility=hidden> )
endif()
if ( MSVC )
  target_compile_options( ${MODULE_NAME} PRIVATE /bigobj )
endif()
endif( LINUX32 )
